whenToUse: Showing an average rating on product cards, listings and review summaries.
Asking for a rating in a review or feedback form (StarRatingInput).
avoidWhen: Ratings without a source or count — say where the number comes from.
Satisfaction surveys with labelled answers — use a Radio group.
a11y: Display is one role="img" named “Rated 4.5 out of 5”.
Input is a native radio group in a fieldset with a legend; every radio is named (“4 stars”).
